# Synthetic credential fixtures

`server-add-test-key` is an encrypted Ed25519 private key generated solely for
unit tests. Its passphrase is ` phrase ` (one space at each end). It is not used
by a real server. The tests verify exact key/passphrase preservation and parsing;
they do not read the user's key files, database or servers.

`proxy-test-ca.der`, `proxy-test-leaf.der` and `proxy-test-key.der` are synthetic
localhost TLS test material generated by `scripts/generate-proxy-fixtures.py`.
They are not trusted outside `cfg(test)`. Never install this CA in an OS trust
store or use the included private key in production. Tests cover a trusted
fixture, untrusted certificates and hostname mismatch. The CA signing key is
discarded during generation.
